technical.summary: Short-term momentum is bullish with rising RSI and supertrend confirmation, but price remains below key moving averages (50/200) and Ichimoku cloud, indicating structural weakness and lack of intermediate trend support.

fundamental.summary: WY shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces elevated volatility risk with earnings in 6 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (27/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional activity and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX 324 crisis regime) combined with critical earnings binary event in 6 days create extreme risk environment for WY.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum (RSI 9 bullish, supertrend bullish, Hull bullish) with price near support (25.26) in extreme fear environment (VIX crisis) offers contrarian entry for tactical bounce.
debate.key_bear_argument: Critical earnings binary in 6 days combined with structural weakness (price below all key MAs, Ichimoku cloud, inverted yield curve, zero fundamental conviction) creates unacceptable risk-reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum (RSI 9, supertrend, Hull bullish) offers tactical bounce setup at support in extreme fear environment. However, critical earnings binary in 6 days and structural weakness below all key moving averages create unacceptable risk-reward asymmetry for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 6 days creates binary event risk that could gap through support (25.26) regardless of technical setup; macro environment (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis) amplifies downside volatility.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; debate winner decisively bear (8 vs 4)
